reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

configurations.purpose: Cheap reversible local or routine software work
configurations.guards: Low relevant consequence, recoverable state, no incompatible external authority requirement.
configurations.dependencies: Existing test must address the changed behavior; evidence identifies the revision.
configurations.alternatives: One competent owner, version control and a focused test; no new control is legitimate.
configurations.omissions: No mandatory central board, formal IVV organization, certification or exhaustive trace matrix.
configurations.cost_tension: Added latency and upkeep can exceed plausible marginal benefit.
configurations.feedback_retirement: Escalate when coupling, external use or persistent state changes the risk; remove unused duplicate artifacts.

configurations.guards: Material uncertainty can be reduced by experiments, and investment remains partially deferrable.
configurations.dependencies: Learning question precedes prototype selection; result changes next commitment.
configurations.alternatives: Simulation, pilot, formal analysis or small increment; stop an infeasible concept.
configurations.omissions: Complete requirements and full certification evidence for throwaway learning are not universally required.
configurations.cost_tension: Experiments can consume budget, create sunk-cost attachment or accidentally become production architecture.
configurations.feedback_retirement: Reassess risk each cycle; adopt staged work for a stable subproblem; stop experiments that cannot change a decision.

configurations.purpose: Iterative high-consequence or externally assured delivery
configurations.guards: Known governing basis, configuration boundary, competent actors and evidence needs.
configurations.dependencies: Evidence credit depends on identified configuration and relevant assumptions; acceptance and authority depend on their own criteria, not merely green tests.
configurations.alternatives: Manual or automated evidence; separate or combined test runs; concise case or larger evidence structure; variable iteration cadence.
configurations.omissions: Not every mechanism is mandatory in every assurance domain; legal minima and consequence determine selection.
configurations.cost_tension: Stacking trace, model, safety case, separate reports and reviews can duplicate the same evidence and delay hazard remediation.
configurations.feedback_retirement: Changed use, environment, tool qualification, interfaces or authority basis invalidates affected credit; reuse unaffected evidence only with justified correspondence.

configurations.purpose: Predominantly staged development for stable risks
configurations.guards: Low requirements/user-interface/integration uncertainty for the chosen scope and substantial budget/schedule coordination risk.
configurations.dependencies: Stability is evidenced; testability and integration planning remain necessary.
configurations.alternatives: Risk-driven iterations for uncertain portions; staged supplier delivery can coexist with internal iteration.
configurations.omissions: Artificially forcing discovery iterations where they cannot change a decision.
configurations.cost_tension: Larger batches risk slow feedback; detailed coordination may be useful but must not conceal new uncertainty.
configurations.feedback_retirement: New critical uncertainty reopens design/requirements; the sequence is not inviolable.
configurations.evidence: S008 p.69 and S013 workflow alternatives; C04.

configurations.guards: Persistent data, distributed dependencies or service continuity are affected.
configurations.dependencies: Recovery claim needs state and dependency scope; operational readiness includes people and contingencies.
configurations.alternatives: Rehearsal, shadow operation, dual-write validation, exposure limits or no migration when safer; examples are options to evaluate, not universal prescriptions.
configurations.omissions: Certification and formal IVV unless actual authority/consequence requires them.
configurations.cost_tension: Redundancy/rehearsal cost versus irreversible loss; extra approval delay can itself sustain a vulnerability.
configurations.feedback_retirement: Observed reconciliation or recovery failure stops expansion; changed data semantics requires re-evaluation.
configurations.evidence: S022, S023, S036, S058; analytical C05.

configurations.guards: Credible harm from delay and a legitimate accelerated authority route.
configurations.dependencies: Expedited decision still binds scope, configuration, evidence and residual risk.
configurations.alternatives: Targeted patch, containment, rollback or suspension of exposed capability.
configurations.omissions: Routine ceremony that adds no decision-relevant evidence; binding requirements remain.
configurations.cost_tension: Latency risk and regression risk coexist; no universal ordering is warranted.
configurations.feedback_retirement: Monitor immediately; restore broader evidence after urgent stabilization where required; terminate exceptions at defined conditions.

configurations.guards: Actual applicability of DOE425.1F or a surviving contractual basis is established.
configurations.dependencies: Review scope and competence precede reliance; review conclusion and startup approval are distinct.
configurations.alternatives: Graded or segmented review and documented approved compensatory measures within the governing route.
configurations.omissions: No universal application to all hazard categories, licensees or industries.
configurations.cost_tension: Preparation and independent review incur cost; private cost-benefit claims cannot waive applicable obligations.
configurations.feedback_retirement: Scope, contract, safety basis or facility-state changes reopen applicability and readiness.

rules.guard: Evidence or authority attaches to a particular item or envelope.
rules.consequence: Identity/correspondence is a premise for transferring the result; absent identity makes that application unestablished.
rules.counter_control: A test can still teach something about an unidentified exploratory prototype; it cannot silently earn credit for a different release.

rules.guard: A verified implementation is offered as proof of intended use, acceptance or authority.
rules.consequence: Verification alone does not discharge stakeholder needs or empowered disposition.
rules.counter_control: A single test may provide evidence for both V and V if designed for both purposes; a single competent actor may hold several authorized roles.

rules.guard: Change affects assumptions, interfaces, claims or context.
rules.consequence: Re-evaluate affected evidence, notify owners and retain still-valid evidence with a correspondence argument.
rules.counter_control: Not every change invalidates every prior artifact; exhaustive re-verification can be wasteful.

rules.guard: Learning risk versus coordination/schedule risk differs across scopes.
rules.consequence: Choose risk cycles, staged commitments or a hybrid; no universal serial composition follows.
rules.counter_control: Boehm’s low-uncertainty staged alternative and existing adequate local controls prevent mandatory iteration/novelty.

rules.guard: Several individually plausible controls are combined.
rules.consequence: Evaluate total evidence-production, maintenance, queue, tool and coordination burden, including duplicated sources and common-mode failure.
rules.counter_control: A binding independent obligation can still require a costly control; the cost rule is constrained, not a private waiver.

rules.guard: An applicable legal, contractual or delegated authority is involved.
rules.consequence: Selection and urgency must remain within the actual versioned authority and permitted exception process.
rules.counter_control: Where no such regime applies, importing its whole apparatus is unjustified.

rules.guard: Rollback is offered as evidence of cheap reversibility.
rules.consequence: Check state, elapsed exposure, external effects and recovery time separately.
rules.counter_control: For an isolated disposable experiment rollback may indeed be enough; do not universalize high-consequence formality.

cases.title: Local reversible formatting change
cases.positive_case: A source-controlled local change with a relevant existing check and recoverable revision has enough identity and feedback for its modest decision.
cases.failure_witness: Adding a central approval queue and exhaustive matrix produces delay without a specified additional risk question.
cases.boundary_nontrigger: If the same file generates an externally certified display, the local-low-consequence premise fails.
cases.counter_control: Keep lightweight identity and the useful test; remove added ceremony, not all control.
cases.evidence_ceiling: Analytical discrimination of context and cumulative burden; no quantified productivity result.

cases.title: Unknown operator workflow before commitment
cases.positive_case: A pilot with intended operators reveals an interaction assumption before a large implementation commitment.
cases.failure_witness: A completed requirements document fails to predict the actual workflow, while the gate prevents prototyping.
cases.boundary_nontrigger: The prototype need not cover already understood stable infrastructure.
cases.counter_control: Retain prior safety constraints and enough architecture to make the experiment interpretable; unlimited improvisation is not the remedy.
cases.evidence_ceiling: Historical and mechanistic support for learning, not proof any prototype improves every outcome.

cases.title: Iterative flight-software work and certification credit
cases.positive_case: Teams iterate while keeping the specific baselined artifact, evidence, trace and authorized disposition needed for the applicable certification basis.
cases.failure_witness: An exploratory test on a mutable build is presented as formal credit for a different release.
cases.boundary_nontrigger: Learning may proceed before formal credit exists; the credit requirement does not prohibit every informal iteration.
cases.counter_control: Keep evidence/configuration binding and applicable independence while changing cadence; educational RTCA guidance cannot waive authority.
cases.evidence_ceiling: Constructed assurance boundary, not an actual certified product or finding of compliance.

cases.title: Stable development with staged commitments
cases.positive_case: Requirements, user interaction and integration risks are demonstrably low; schedule/budget coordination dominates, making a predominantly staged plan reasonable.
cases.failure_witness: A new technical risk or changing user need invalidates that premise and should reopen iteration, rather than be hidden to preserve the baseline.
cases.boundary_nontrigger: Stability is assessed for the relevant scope, not assumed from project size or a signed contract.
cases.counter_control: Permit staged development under Boehm’s stated conditions while rejecting universal fixed one-pass sequencing.
cases.evidence_ceiling: Analytical admissibility supported by source discussion; not an empirical ranking of lifecycle alternatives.

cases.title: Data migration with a misleading rollback claim
cases.positive_case: A migration plan rehearses state conversion and recovery, reconciles actual deployment, and identifies consequences that code rollback cannot reverse.
cases.failure_witness: The binary rolls back successfully but overwritten customer records remain lost.
cases.boundary_nontrigger: A disposable test database without dependent users can take a cheaper path.
cases.counter_control: Keep backup verification, staged exposure or a reversible data design as alternatives; a document alone does not restore state.
cases.evidence_ceiling: Finite constructed counterexample to rollback-implies-reversibility; not a universal risk formula.

cases.title: Urgent patch with independent authority
cases.positive_case: A credible exploited vulnerability invokes a preauthorized accelerated route with targeted tests, current identity and residual-risk decision.
cases.failure_witness: Waiting for the ordinary calendar board increases exposure; bypassing all checks can also introduce a catastrophic regression.
cases.boundary_nontrigger: If impact is entirely isolated and harmless the exceptional route may be unnecessary.
cases.counter_control: A binding authority can approve a constrained expedited route; urgency does not create legal permission by itself.
cases.evidence_ceiling: Reasoned latency-versus-assurance trade-off. No target incident was observed or acted upon.

cases.title: Good trace links, mixed task results and total cost
cases.positive_case: Relevant current links can shorten search and improve a bounded maintenance answer.
cases.failure_witness: Even the inspected supplied-link experiment reports lower fully-correct performance on one task; stale or overly broad links can misdirect a maintainer.
cases.boundary_nontrigger: A maintainer who already knows a tiny local code area may gain little from a new matrix.
cases.counter_control: Retain selective usable links and check their semantics; count upkeep rather than import the experiment’s setup-only break-even estimate.
cases.evidence_ceiling: Observed study limits inform a constructed transfer case; no new experiment or independent replication claim.

cases.title: Nuclear startup, edition and surviving contract
cases.positive_case: A covered HC1/2 startup uses the applicable order and approvals, graded readiness scope, competent assessment and documented exceptions.
cases.failure_witness: A project treats cancellation of E as erasing incorporated contractual duties, or treats F as globally applicable to all facilities.
cases.boundary_nontrigger: Outside the order’s applicability, another governing basis must be determined rather than importing the process by analogy.
cases.counter_control: Maintain jurisdiction and contract version as separate premises; economic tailoring stays inside binding requirements.
cases.evidence_ceiling: Normative illustration, not legal advice about a specific facility or permission to start it.

cases.title: Model, pipeline and reality disagree
cases.positive_case: A maintained model and generated evidence can aid a decision when semantics, authority and actual-state reconciliation are explicit.
cases.failure_witness: The model and tests agree with each other while the deployed supplier component differs; internal consistency does not establish external adequacy.
cases.boundary_nontrigger: A simple verified configuration record may be more economical than a new model suite.
cases.counter_control: Compare model assumptions to actual items and use independent evidence where common-mode error matters.
cases.evidence_ceiling: Constructed failure of evidence inference; no claim all model-based engineering fails.

criticism_response_supplement.criticism: Historic authors were sanitized into modern iterative advocates.
criticism_response_supplement.finding: Royce’s pilots and feedback coexist with strong formal documentation; Benington retrospective differs from his original staging text.
criticism_response_supplement.consequence: Reject both one-pass caricature and retroactive modern-method branding.

criticism_response_supplement.criticism: Rejecting a universal lifecycle silently bans every staged development.
criticism_response_supplement.finding: Boehm’s p.69 conditions preserve staged development as one risk-driven configuration.
criticism_response_supplement.consequence: EW-P034 rejects a universal, not K04.

criticism_response_supplement.criticism: Repeated trace publications count as independent replication or show universal task benefit.
criticism_response_supplement.finding: 2012 uses supplied links, reports task interaction and excludes upkeep cost; exact2015 dataset relation unresolved.
criticism_response_supplement.consequence: One dependence family; conditional P017 and negative P037 retained.

criticism_response_supplement.criticism: Absence of delayed-issue effect makes late change harmless.
criticism_response_supplement.finding: TSP development effort does not measure post-delivery loss or all commitment costs.
criticism_response_supplement.consequence: P038 rejects universal exponential law while P003/P028/P033 remain conditional.

criticism_response_supplement.criticism: A standard’s date or current edition automatically authorizes present practice.
criticism_response_supplement.finding: IEEE designation/publication dates differ; DOE successor is scoped and preserves contract commitments; draft SSDF is separate.

criticism_response_supplement.criticism: The safety case, model or automated pipeline is itself assurance.
criticism_response_supplement.finding: MASSC warns of documentary pathology; model evidence remains limited; cATO has explicit organizational prerequisites.
criticism_response_supplement.consequence: P019/P030/P031 demand interpretable current evidence rather than artifact existence.

criticism_response_supplement.criticism: Risk-proportional tailoring can privately waive mandatory controls.
criticism_response_supplement.finding: Original P024/P033 already identify legal minima. Retain those guards and make them explicit in the top-level cost rule.
criticism_response_supplement.consequence: P024/P033 and overall verdict explicitly constrained.

criticism_response_supplement.criticism: Every failed staged process can be dismissed as an inauthentic implementation.
criticism_response_supplement.finding: Ericsson case studied an actual process; delayed feedback and missing baselines are both relevant adverse evidence.
criticism_response_supplement.consequence: Preserve failure findings without inferring a universal ban or lifecycle causal effect.

candidates_examined.reason: Binding identity to repeated evidence refines the receiving warrant; it is not a new non-subsumed property.
Removing authority creates a false waiver implication, but the new result is an applicability constraint already expressible by existing rows.
Conditional sequencing is represented by K02/K04 and the narrowed negative; extra identity would double-count.

source_record.claim: No universal serial lifecycle or all-controls package is established.
source_record.cost_rule: Joint configuration cost includes upkeep, latency, duplicated evidence, scarce competence/tooling and common-mode failure, constrained by applicable obligations.
